title: Windows runner starts in the user folder with the working folder out of DLL search
context: Second review of 99b40058: Documents as the process working folder holds that folder open (OneDrive Known Folder Move or the Location tab cannot move Documents while Field Notes runs) and adds a user-writable folder to LoadLibrary's search, reached by shell extensions loaded into the file dialogs; changing the folder after engine threads start is also against Microsoft guidance.
options: Keep Documents and accept the folder lock
Persist the last export folder in Dart and pass it as initialDirectory
Start in FOLDERID_Profile before the engine starts and call SetDllDirectoryW(L"") first in wWinMain
outcome: FOLDERID_Profile at the top of RunFieldNotes plus SetDllDirectoryW(L"") at the top of wWinMain (d4afbc1b). Nobody moves the profile folder, the first dialog opens in the user's home with Documents, Downloads and Pictures one click away, Windows reopens the last folder afterwards, and the working folder is out of DLL search entirely (stricter than main). Cost: the first dialog starts one level above Documents rather than in it, unlike macOS.
